reasons.claim: In his conservative base case the stock's intrinsic value of 1,000 is still far below the current price for a 10% return.
reasons.quote: on that intrinsic value is 1,000 still far from the current levels for a 10% expected return

data_check.gap_note: not in our data: intrinsic value, expected return

reasons.claim: If growth is shortened to a burst of 40% for two years and then continues, the stock is priced for a 10-15% return.
reasons.quote: if you do that and you start with a 60% earnings per share and then go forward then you can see that immediately with the low estimations it is priced right for a 10% return

data_check.gap_note: he says 0.4, as-of 0.0453701 (FY2025); annual vs TTM or a different definition; not in our data: expected return

reasons.claim: MercadoLibre is building an Amazon-plus-fintech ecosystem across a huge underpenetrated Latin American market, which is a strong long-term growth driver.
reasons.quote: So it looks like the Amazon of Latin America, they are investing and therefore their profitability is declining a little bit

reasons.claim: Latin America is highly cyclical and the stock could fall 40-60% in a downturn, so risk is elevated at the current (upper) part of the cycle.
reasons.quote: there are many risks starting with Latin America. Everything goes up and down, up and down there, up and down

data_check.gap_note: he says 0.6, as-of -0.38484 (5y); annual vs TTM or a different definition

reasons.claim: Management can flexibly dial margins up or down as opportunities evolve, unlike Wall Street's linear worry about margin suppression.
reasons.quote: We have the ability to dial the margins up and down and circumstances and opportunities evolve
